note: Triennial election of Irvinestown Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964 (no poll was needed). The Impartial Reporter of 21 May 1964, p. 7, reports the close of nominations: 'There will be no contests for Irvinestown Rural Council - 19 nominations were handed in, one for each division', with three changes (Belleek, Churchhill, Lisnarick) and the other sixteen nominations, all named by division. Replaces Mr. Edward Corrigan. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Churchhill' to Church Hill (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Church Hill; the rounds were filed as Churchhill (1924, 1927, 1930, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1961, 1964); Churchill (1933, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Churchhill', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (churchhill) answers with a redirect to this one.
